ResStock 2025 Release 1 Measure Documentation: Duct Sealing and Insulation Accessing Results This documentation covers the “duct sealing and insulation” measure upgrade methodology and briefly discusses key results. All results are available on the ResStock™ Open Energy Data Initiative “End-Use Load Profiles for the U.S. Building Stock” data lake and on the data viewer at resstock.nlr.gov. Measure Summary Measure Title Duct Sealing and Insulation Measure This upgrade measure involves sealing HVAC ducts and adding insulation in Definition applicable dwelling units. After the upgrade, the units will achieve 5% duct leakage to the outside and an R-8 duct insulation level. Applicability This measure applies to all dwellings
